description: Local Falcon gives ChatGPT and Codex access to AI visibility and local search intelligence across Google Maps, Apple Maps, and supported AI search platforms. Analyze geo-grid rankings, AI search visibility, competitors, trends, and reviews; run scans using existing account credits; manage campaigns and Falcon Guard; and inspect or update connected Google Business Profiles. Interactive geo-grid reports turn ranking data into actionable geographic insights. The plugin uses an existing Local Falcon account and does not offer purchases, checkout, subscription changes, or recharge controls.
